description: This script appears to process log files to detect embedded trash directories, extract their content, and handle line ending inconsistencies, primarily for build logs in a CI environment.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Prints an error message to standard error and exits with status 1.

methods.name: find_embedded_trash
methods.description: Reads lines to detect the start of an embedded trash directory, extracting its name.

methods.name: extract_embedded_trash
methods.description: Reads lines to extract the contents of an embedded trash directory until the end marker.
